title: Console backend APIs for route experiments (CRUD + start/stop + status + audit trail)
text:
Console backend APIs for route experiments (CRUD + start/stop + status + audit trail)

description:
Build the Console backend API surface for route-level experiments so Console UI (and internal tooling) can create/update experiments, start/stop them safely, fetch experiment status, retrieve results pointers, and retrieve audit trail.

Context
- This ticket is the “Console API” layer (RBAC-gated) that translates Console actions into control-plane experiment configs + lifecycle transitions.
- Router/policy engine execution and attribution are handled elsewhere (ENG-9022 / ENG-9026).
- Audit event emission is handled by ENG-9030 but the Console API must ensure it passes correct metadata (actor, diff summary, request ids) and exposes the audit trail read API.

Scope (MVP → Beta)
1) Mutation endpoints (RBAC gated)
- Create experiment: validates input, persists draft, returns experiment_id + initial version.
- Update experiment: only allowed in DRAFT (and/or STOPPED per final state machine), bumps config version.
- Start experiment: transitions to RUNNING, writes effective allocations + eligibility rules, triggers config propagation (async), returns state + config_version.
- Stop experiment: transitions to STOPPING then STOPPED (drain semantics: routing stops immediately; metrics continue to arrive). Console should display intermediate state.
- Delete experiment: only allowed in DRAFT/STOPPED, hard delete for now; keep audit events.

2) Read endpoints
- Get experiment: returns config + state + summary guardrails config + created/updated metadata.
- List experiments: pagination + basic filters (route_id, status, created_by, updated_at).
- Get status: lightweight endpoint for list polling (state, last_transition_at, propagation lag summary, degraded flag).
- Get audit trail: returns normalized audit events for the experiment lifecycle and config diffs.

3) Validation (server-side)
- Validate variants/allocation sums to 1.0 with tolerated float epsilon.
- Enforce max variants (per GA defaults; start with 5).
- Enforce route_id normalization rules (template not raw path) and block empty route set.
- Enforce eligibility rules constraints (no unsupported matchers; hard limit size).
- Enforce “no overlapping active experiments per route” policy (final policy: block at start time; allow multiple drafts).
- Validate model compatibility / fallback interactions at start time (calls policy engine validation hook; surface actionable errors).
- Sticky key config validation: if defaulting to low-entropy key, return warning field used by Console UI.

4) RBAC / AuthZ
- Require role-based permissions for mutations:
  - create/update/delete: Console:Experiments:Write
  - start/stop: Console:Experiments:Operate
  - view/audit: Console:Experiments:Read
- Break-glass: platform-admin can stop any experiment; must be explicitly logged with elevated flag.

5) Audit logging
- Emit audit events on create/update/start/stop/delete with:
  - actor_id, actor_email, org_id, experiment_id, route_ids
  - config_version, diff_summary, request_id, source=console
  - redaction for any customer identifiers included in eligibility rules
- Expose audit read API to Console audit drawer and export workflows (read-only; pagination).

Non-goals
- No statistical significance computation; results API is separate (ENG-28644 / analytics rollups).
- No customer-defined custom metrics ingestion.

Proposed API shape (internal; names subject to change)
- POST   /v1/console/route-experiments
- PATCH  /v1/console/route-experiments/{experiment_id}
- POST   /v1/console/route-experiments/{experiment_id}:start
- POST   /v1/console/route-experiments/{experiment_id}:stop
- DELETE /v1/console/route-experiments/{experiment_id}
- GET    /v1/console/route-experiments/{experiment_id}
- GET    /v1/console/route-experiments?route_id=&status=&cursor=&limit=
- GET    /v1/console/route-experiments/{experiment_id}/status
- GET    /v1/console/route-experiments/{experiment_id}/audit-events?cursor=&limit=

State machine (initial)
- DRAFT -> RUNNING -> STOPPING -> STOPPED
- DRAFT -> DELETED
- STOPPED -> RUNNING (restart allowed; bumps config_version; requires re-validation)
- Guards:
  - update allowed only in DRAFT (and optionally STOPPED if restart path is used)
  - start allowed only in DRAFT/STOPPED
  - stop allowed only in RUNNING

Acceptance criteria
- All endpoints implemented behind route-experiments feature flag (beta allowlist); safe no-op/404 when disabled.
- Integration tests cover:
  - RBAC deny/allow for all mutations
  - create/update validation errors are actionable and map to Console form fields
  - start-time overlap check prevents two RUNNING experiments on same route
  - audit events emitted for lifecycle transitions with required fields
  - list API pagination stable + performance acceptable (no N+1 joins)
- Docs stub for Console UI integration (request/response schema + error codes) shared with Console frontend.

References
- PRD: confluence/product-docs/requirements/route-level-ab-testing-prd.json
- ADRs: ADR-047 deterministic bucketing, ADR-048 metrics attribution schema
- Audit requirements: confluence/security-and-compliance/audit-logging/experiment-config-audit-events.json

comments:
2025-02-03 (Chloe Martin): Drafting endpoint list + state machine proposal. Biggest open question: do we allow UPDATE in STOPPED or require clone? Leaning allow STOPPED update w/ config_version bump; will confirm with Marissa + SRE.
2025-02-05 (Dylan Brooks): Please align error format with existing Rollouts APIs (field_errors[] + global_errors[]). Console wizard needs to highlight per-field validation failures (allocations, route selection, eligibility).
2025-02-06 (Kaitlyn Nguyen): RBAC: propose new permission strings under Console domain rather than reusing Rollouts:Write. Also need break-glass stop permission for platform-admin; make sure audit event has elevated=true.
2025-02-07 (Jordan Lee): Start-time validation should call policy-engine “dry-run” validator to catch model compatibility + fallback interactions. Otherwise users will start an experiment that never takes traffic due to downstream rejection.
2025-02-10 (Chloe Martin): Implemented initial CRUD + start/stop handlers in console-api service; wiring to experiment service via internal gRPC. Next: audit emission + list pagination indexes.
2025-02-12 (Felix Schneider): For status endpoint, Console needs propagation lag + degraded reason summary. Can we return {propagation_lag_seconds, last_published_version, last_seen_version}? Even if best-effort.
2025-02-14 (Marcus Lin): Security review note: audit read endpoint must redact eligibility rule values if they can contain customer-provided identifiers. Also ensure debug endpoints stay internal-only (separate ticket).
2025-02-18 (Chloe Martin): Added overlap check at START (block if any RUNNING experiment shares a route_id). Allow multiple drafts on same route. Returning error_code=OVERLAPPING_ACTIVE_EXPERIMENT with conflicting_experiment_id in message for now (no nested field).
2025-02-20 (Rafael Mendes): Stop semantics: prefer STOPPING state for up to 2 minutes to allow propagation; routing should stop immediately, but we want UI to show “stopping” until config is confirmed removed. Add last_transition_at and propagation_confirmed_at fields.
2025-02-24 (Chloe Martin): Performance: list endpoint was doing join on audit table for updated_at; moved updated_at to experiments table and added index (org_id, updated_at desc). Should address slow list issue seen in staging.
2025-03-03 (Chloe Martin): Feature flag gating added (route_experiments_enabled). Disabled returns 404 for read endpoints and 403 w/ message for mutations; matches other gated Console features.
2025-03-06 (Kevin Osei): Audit export needs stable event_type names: EXPERIMENT_CREATED/UPDATED/STARTED/STOPPED/DELETED. Also include request_id and actor_ip if available. Please ensure Console API passes through trace_id.
2025-03-10 (Chloe Martin): All endpoints passing integration tests locally. Pending: hook audit diff_summary formatting from ENG-9030 implementation; currently we emit ‘changed_fields=[…]’ only.
2025-03-17 (Dylan Brooks): Please coordinate with Console UI on start/stop idempotency: hitting start twice should return 200 with current state, not 500. Same for stop. We’ve had support pain here on Rollouts.
2025-03-20 (Chloe Martin): Implemented idempotency for start/stop (if already in target state, return success). Added explicit error for invalid transition with error_code=INVALID_STATE_TRANSITION.
2025-03-27 (Logan Wright): Reminder: results API may be owned elsewhere; don’t bake metric queries into Console API. Status endpoint can include attribution drop rate as optional field later, but keep minimal for beta.
2025-04-09 (Chloe Martin): Marking Done. Merged + deployed behind feature flag. UI now unblocked to wire creation wizard + list/detail pages. Follow-up ticket needed for richer diff summaries in audit view once export format is finalized.
